SQLPAGE_WEB_ROOT.description: Sqlpage web root for core. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

SQLPAGE_CONFIGURATION_DIRECTORY.description: Sqlpage configuration directory for core. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

DATABASE_URL.description: Private PostgreSQL connection URL assembled from generated credentials and service references. No manual value is needed.

RAILWAY_DOCKERFILE_PATH.description: Repository-relative Dockerfile used to build this service. Keep the supplied path.

UPSTREAM_HOST.description: Upstream host resolved automatically from the linked service. Keep this reference when using the included topology.

UPSTREAM_PORT.description: Upstream port for sqlpage. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

OWNER_AUTH.description: Owner auth for sqlpage. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

OWNER_SCOPE.description: Owner scope for sqlpage. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

ACCESS_PASSWORD.description: Generated access password. Keep private and preserve with backups.

PORT.description: HTTP port inside this service. Keep the default to match its Railway public port and health check.

RAILWAY_DOCKERFILE_PATH.description: Repository-relative Dockerfile used to build this service. Keep the supplied path.
